eloise: Hey team — PR #4312: cleaned up telemetry, removed duplicate 'request_duration' metric, added a unit test for meter aggregation, and swapped a couple of log lines to DEBUG. PTAL — hoping to merge before the weekend cutoff (need one approver).
sam: quick skim: looks good. One nit: change log level for 'heartbeat' to TRACE? otherwise LGTM.
eloise: good call, changed heartbeat to TRACE and pushed. test run locally: `pytest tests/test_metrics.py::test_aggregation -q` passed.
jin: left a tiny naming suggestion on the last commit (metric -> meter) — not blocking.
eloise: addressed naming nit and force-pushed (squashed minor fix). PTAL @sam @jin @anil
anil: I can take a look in ~1.5h, heads-up I have a meeting now.
sam: rechecked the latest commit, no issues. Approved from me :+1: (will not merge, leaving for an approver if needed).
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window request: PR #4312 -> canary Sat 02:30 UTC. CI status: running.
eloise: thanks all. if CI green and @anil approves, i'll merge and tag the deploy window.
anil: Approved. safe to merge from my side. :shipit:
eloise: merging now, will watch CI and open a rollback PR if anything weird appears. thanks!
